items.title: Roy Palmer Interview, 1955-09-22
items.q: Who else was in that band? ... George Fewclose.

ctx.x: That's right. Charlie Fewclose. Charlie Fewclose. Yeah. Uh-huh, yeah. George Fewclose. George. George Fewclose. Who else was in that band? Oh, we had some boys instruments. Okay. Okay. The instruments they use now, trumpets and trombones and so on, the most they use now is a shallow mouthpiece. Not so deep, a shallow mouthpiece. They're made special for high notes, see? And when you have high notes to make, it's easy with those mouthpieces. It produces a high tone, and you have to figure out, you have to work…
the bell on the trombones. I don't know much
